Circular plot

Source: R/rose.R
circular_plot.Rd

Polar diagram where angles increase clockwise.

Usage

circular_plot(
  main = NULL,
  sub = NULL,
  labels = TRUE,
  at = c(grid.lines, grid.lines + 180),
  cborder = TRUE,
  radius = 1,
  scale = 1.1,
  grid = FALSE,
  grid.lines = seq(0, 135, 45),
  grid.circles = seq(0.2, radius, 0.2),
  origin.text = "N",
  ...
)

Arguments

main

a main title for the plot, see also title.

sub

a subtitle for the plot.

labels

Either a logical value indicating whether to plot labels next to the tick marks, or a vector of labels for the tick marks.

at

Optional vector of angles at which tick marks should be plotted. Set at=numeric(0) to suppress tick marks.

cborder

logical. Whether to plot the primitive of the circular plot (TRUE by default) or not.

radius

numeric. The radius of the circular plot. 1 by default.

scale

numeric. Increases the radius of the border to have some in-plot clearance. 1.1 by default

grid

logical. Whether to add a grid to the circular plot. Default is FALSE.

grid.lines, grid.circles

numeric. Adds a sequence of straight grid lines and circles based on angles (in degrees) and radii, respectively. Ignored when grid=FALSE

origin.text

character. String to be drawn at the top margin of the plot ("N" by default)

...

optional parameters passed to graphics::symbols() for plotting border of circular plot. Ignored if cborder=FALSE.

Value

none

Examples

circular_plot(grid = TRUE)
